message.content: {"reachable":false,"rationale":"Blocked configSecret:credentialAccess prevents ssoLogin:authenticate; together with blocked apiToken:authenticate and memoryDump:credentialAccess, this makes appServer:lateralMovement unreachable. Blocked sshKey:credentialAccess prevents dbLogin:authenticate and vpnSession:authenticate, while blocked memoryDump:credentialAccess prevents rdpLogin:authenticate. Consequently jumpHost, fileServer, hypervisor, printServer, localAdmin, serviceAccount, and secretsManager cannot be reached. All four target parents—vaultRead:collection, codeRepo:collection, shareMount:collection, and dbReplica:collection—are therefore unreachable."}
